topic: Relay Task Kernel: One Handoff Contract for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Copilot

competitors.title: RTK — Relay Task Kernel (the source project, ~2 stars, MIT)
key_points: Zero-dependency Node CLI (Node >= 18.17) that makes AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, and .github/copilot-instructions.md thin pointers to one shared contract
Solves the 'write the rules four times' problem: each agent gets its own entry file but all point to one RTK.md core protocol
Writes machine-wide protocol to ~/.rtk/ (RTK.md, rules/, templates/, schemas/) plus a project overlay under .rtk/
Four core units: Task Packet (start), Context Capsule (during), Memory Patch (.rtk/memory), Handoff Capsule (end)
Fenced-merge contract: RTK manages only regions between <!-- RTK:BEGIN --> and <!-- RTK:END --> markers; idempotent, non-destructive, reversible (backups), and checkable via 'rtk check'
The overlay may only tighten: a project rule can forbid something global allows, never the reverse
Memory is four markdown files (project-brief, current-state, user-preferences, mistakes-to-avoid), not a database
Zero-dependency philosophy: writes markdown, no dependency tree

competitors.title: Baton — Desktop app for cross-agent AI handoffs
key_points: Pass project context, git diffs, and task states seamlessly between Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI and more
GUI-based handoff vs RTK's file/CLI approach
Focuses on carrying git diffs and task state, not a shared rules contract

competitors.title: Handoff — preserve coding context when agents run out of tokens (~19 stars)
key_points: Handoff context from one agent to another agent
Solves token-runout and session-loss by preserving context between agents
Similar goal to RTK's Handoff Capsule but as a standalone tool rather than a full contract

competitors.title: design.md — a clearer handoff for coding agents
key_points: Design.md is a format spec (google-labs-code/design.md, ~27K stars) for describing visual identity to coding agents
Positioned as 'a clearer handoff for coding agents' from Shuffle/VoltAgent
Shows the broader movement of standard handoff files (DESIGN.md, SKILL.md, AGENTS.md) for cross-agent clarity

competitors.title: Evolve SDK — open-source Manus powered by Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI
key_points: Agent orchestration SDK that runs across Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI
Uses AGENTS.md-style shared context and structured handoff for multi-agent execution
Proof that cross-agent handoff is an active ecosystem theme in 2026

stats.fact: RTK is zero-dependency and targets Node >= 18.17, with 31 tests and no dependency tree.
Each major coding agent expects a different instruction file: AGENTS.md (Codex), CLAUDE.md (Claude Code), GEMINI.md (Gemini CLI), .github/copilot-instructions.md (Copilot).
RTK started as an internal PowerShell script for a Traditional Chinese content site run by Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini in rotation, covering about 90 published articles.

RTK's merge contract is idempotent (re-run on unchanged repo reports '0 file(s) changed'), non-destructive, reversible (leaves CLAUDE.backup.<timestamp>.md), and checkable via 'rtk check' (exit 1 on tampering).
RTK's machine-readable task packet schema (task-packet.schema.json) requires fields: goal, scope, out_of_scope, validation, risks.
design.md (google-labs-code/design.md) has ~27,426 stars as an open format spec for describing a visual identity to coding agents.
TStansel/handoff (~19 stars) and kzoldyk/baton (~2 stars) are independent tools in the same cross-agent handoff niche as RTK.
The handoff-capsule.md template carries: Current State, Completed, Not Completed, Dirty Worktree/Pending Files, Validation Run, Risks, and Next Suggested Step.
RTK presets (content-site, oss-library) add publishing/deploy gates so drafts never leak to production and agents never touch versions/tags/releases.

angles: The 'write rules once' problem: most multi-agent projects duplicate project instructions across 4 files, and RTK collapses them to thin pointers over one shared contract
Handoff is both a rules contract AND a memory problem — RTK's four units (Task Packet, Context Capsule, Memory Patch, Handoff Capsule) cover task start, execution, learning, and handoff
The fenced-merge contract (<!-- RTK:BEGIN/END -->) is the key innovation: idempotent, non-destructive, reversible, and CI-checkable — solving 'agent silently loses its rules'
The overlay-may-only-tighten rule prevents one careless commit from disabling global safety rules

Real-world origin story: RTK was forged running a 90-article Traditional Chinese content site across three agents in rotation — credibility via real incidents (published drafts, prod deploys, lost decisions)
Zero-dependency markdown-writer philosophy vs dependency-heavy orchestration SDKs (Evolve SDK) and GUI tools (Baton)
Positioning within the broader 2026 standardization wave: AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md, SKILL.md — RTK is the handoff/task-transfer member of the family
Presets encode workflow gates (content-site publishing gate, oss-library release guard) making the contract project-type-aware
